column1: Clause 2: This clause amends the Code of Criminal Procedure Act, No. 15 of 1979 (hereinafter
referred to as the “principal enactment”), by inserting new section 144A in that Act and the legal
effect of the amendment is to make provisions to empower the Magistrate to dispense the personal
attendance of a suspect or accused in court under the circumstances specified in that section.
